title: FOMC-instant drained-liquidity under-reaction: announcement-bar taker-side continuation on the exogenous decision clock (H1)

measured_facts_used_verbatim.panel: H1 UTC, 3 symbols BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT, 8760 rows/symbol, window 2025-08-22T00..2026-08-21T23 (p0_gate.json panel_bounds PASS)
measured_facts_used_verbatim.instants: 8 FOMC decision instants, 2025-09-17..2026-07-29, official publication timestamps DST-correct (p0_calendar_census.json, verdict PASS_WITH_BLS_BLOCKED)
measured_facts_used_verbatim.forbidden_conditioning: CPI/NFP instants DO NOT EXIST in evidence (BLS blocked 403); this proposal conditions on NOTHING except the 8 evidenced FOMC instants

mechanism.forced_participant: Passive quote/liquidity providers on the three USD-perp books who withdraw or widen quotes into the scheduled FOMC decision instant because carrying inventory through a known macro print violates their inventory/VaR limits. They are forced by the SCHEDULE (a public, exogenous, PIT-evidenced instant), not by any endogenous price/OI/funding state.
mechanism.late_participant: Discretionary post-print followers (US-afternoon systematic re-riskers, late manual flow) who execute over the hours after the print rather than at it.
mechanism.why_effect_exists: At the print, one-sided informed taker flow meets a deliberately thinned book, so the initial repricing is partial. As providers re-quote and late participants execute over the following hours, the announcement-bar direction continues instead of instantly clearing. The book trades the residual continuation of the announcement bar's taker side, which exists only because the print instant drained liquidity first.
when_it_must_fail: If crypto participants fully pre-position before the instant, the announcement bar's taker side carries no residual information: anchor after-cost expectancy is statistically indistinguishable from zero.
If H1 taker-side direction is generically autocorrelated with no clock needed, the sham-instant placebo reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) and the family is falsified as a re-clocking.
If the book is a bare clock artifact, the clock-only shadow out-earns the anchor or correlates > 0.20 with it.
If the book is a low-liquidity-LEVEL exposure in disguise (the WKNDLIQ trap), D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the dvol proxies kills it before selection.

observable_pinned.definition: imb(symbol, s) = (buy_quote - sell_quote) / quote_total computed on the announcement bar A(s) of the frozen S4 panel
observable_pinned.instant_source: p0_calendar_census.json instants (series US-MACRO/FOMC_DECISION), DST-correct UTC per official 'For release at 2:00 p.m. EST/EDT' evidence

clock.bar: H1 UTC from the frozen S4 panels, bar hour_utc=T covers [T, T+1h)
clock.announcement_bar: A(s) = the bar whose hour_utc equals the instant's UTC hour on the instant's date (the release lands on A's open boundary; e.g. 2025-09-17T18:00:00Z -> bar '2025-09-17T18')
clock.decision: at the CLOSE of bar A(s), the first bar close at which the full announcement bar is point-in-time
clock.instant_alignment: UTC, DST-correct from census evidence (14:00 EDT = 18:00Z; 14:00 EST = 19:00Z); no CPI/NFP instants exist and none are used

warmup.rule: an instant is eligible only if the symbol has >= 500 prior H1 bars in the panel before the instant's date
warmup.coverage: panel starts 2025-08-22T00; first instant 2025-09-17 has 26 days x 24 = 624 bars >= 500, therefore ALL 8 instants x 3 symbols are eligible; no instant dropped
warmup.signal_history: none required (anchor direction uses bar A only; no threshold fitting exists)

columns_from_panel.buy_quote: USD notional of buy-taker flow in bar (quote units)
columns_from_panel.sell_quote: USD notional of sell-taker flow in bar
columns_from_panel.last_price: last traded price in bar, used as the bar-close fill price

features_lags.lag_structure: single-bar feature at lag 0 relative to the decision (bar A itself); exit price at lag +H bars (A+H close). No other lags, no rolling windows, no fitted parameters.

entry_exit_fills.direction: d = sign(imb) = sign((buy_quote - sell_quote)/quote_total) on bar A; tie buy_quote == sell_quote exactly -> decision recorded UNFUNDED_SKIP (counted, not silently dropped)
entry_exit_fills.entry: at close of A(s), fill price = last_price of bar A(s), unit notional 1.0 per decision per symbol, no leverage parameter, no sizing conditioning
entry_exit_fills.exit: at close of A(s)+H, fill price = last_price of bar A(s)+H; no stop, no early exit
entry_exit_fills.fills_per_funded_decision: 2 (entry + exit), each charged cost exactly once (L-V14-0)

costs.authority: measured taker + spread schedule at stress tier 2.0 as PRIMARY (Q-2/Q-8), inherited from the V17 scored-driver kernel adoption at this cycle's P1 phase; cost exactly once per fill
costs.invention_disclaimer: NO cost constant is stated or invented in this proposal; the measured tier numbers come from the kernel's measured schedule at execution time. Measured beats stated everywhere.

anchor.decisions: 8 instants x 3 symbols = 24 funded decisions (minus exact-tie skips, expected 0)

neighbour.rule: identical direction rule and grid; H = 12 bars
neighbour.mechanism_support: if the drained-liquidity continuation is real, the longer horizon must retain the sign with graceful decay; a horizon cliff or sign flip contradicts the mechanism (different parameterization, same mechanism)

causal_placebo_control.rule: sham FOMC clock: each instant shifted +1 FOMC session index (session i date -> session i+1 date, same DST-correct release hour); session 8's shifted instant falls beyond the panel end -> dropped fail-closed
causal_placebo_control.decisions: 7 sessions x 3 symbols = 21 decisions; everything else identical to anchor (H = 6)
causal_placebo_control.identifiability: the sham moves instants to real alternate trading days with real microstructure; it CAN move the signal (Q-11 satisfied; a control that cannot move the signal would be INVALID NULL)

clock_only_shadow.rule: identical decision grid, holds (H = 6), costs and books; direction = +1 at EVERY decision (pure clock-long exposure carrying zero panel information)
clock_only_shadow.purpose: isolates what the bare exogenous clock yields; if the anchor is subsumed by this exposure the mechanism claim is empty

arms.pairwise_distinctness: the four arms differ by (direction rule, H, instant map) and will carry distinct arm_config_digests at D2/I time; no two arms share all three

representation_identity.p12_statement: This block IS the representation D2 must measure pooled |rho| <= 0.20 on. Representation identity = measurement identity (FXFV9 lesson: no undisclosed variant grids).
representation_identity.grid: H1 rows keyed (symbol, hour_utc) from the three frozen S4 panels (digests pinned in p0_gate.json s4_repin); decision grid = 24 rows keyed (symbol, instant) over the 8 census instants
representation_identity.signal_computation: per decision row: imb = (buy_quote - sell_quote)/quote_total on bar A; d = sign(imb); entry = last_price(A); exit = last_price(A+H)
representation_identity.per_decision_return: r = d * (exit/entry - 1), gross; after-cost r_net = r - 2 * fill_cost_tier2.0 / unit_notional
series_d2_measures: the 24-row per-decision after-cost return vector of ANCHOR (primary)
the same vectors for NEIGH-H12 for the ancestry panel
representation_identity.books: per-symbol books and the pooled 3-symbol book; equal unit notional per decision; no cross-sectional ranking, no normalization across symbols
representation_identity.no_hidden_variants: no monthly-grid variant, no alternate span, no sign-flipped re-computation exists or may be substituted at D2; any re-measure must use exactly this representation or be recorded as a NEW proposal

ancestry_defense: WKNDLIQ was a recurring weekday calendar whose book was measured to BE a low-liquidity-level exposure (pooled |rho| 0.5628 vs dvol proxies); P1 conditions on no liquidity LEVEL at all - the only conditioning variable is the SIGN of taker-side imbalance on 8 exogenous, PIT-evidenced instants, with volume appearing only inside a bounded ratio. FUNDJUMP consumed the funding series and its announced-change form still carried the funding LEVEL (rho 0.2439); P1 consumes no funding, no OI, and no announcement content - only the census clock and panel flow columns. ATTN-PHASE was a daily recurring US-session attention phase on SOL; P1's clock is 8 non-recurring exogenous decision instants and the reaction is imbalance-directed, not session-conditioned. CLOSE-DISPLACE-FADE and RUNPERSIST are dead at ANY clock as endogenous boundary forms; P1 neither fades a displacement nor persists a run - it takes the announcement bar's taker side from an exogenous instant, and the sham-instant + clock-only controls exist precisely to falsify any re-clocking interpretation.
distinctness_vs_sibling: P1's information source is the POST-instant announcement-bar taker side; P2 (CNG1-A4-P2) uses the PRE-instant accumulated taker pressure over A-4..A-1 with a different reaction form (deadline-flow realization, not under-reaction continuation). Different information-source layer AND different reaction form, not a parameter swap. Cross-proposal collapse is tested by frozen rule F5.

falsification_rule.no_rescue: no threshold, horizon, or direction rule may change after any scored/smoke number is visible (P-15); any violation is a new hypothesis

rules.condition: CTL-SHIFTPLUS1 after-cost expectancy same sign as ANCHOR with |CTL| >= 0.5 x |ANCHOR|
rules.consequence: FALSIFIED - the FOMC clock adds nothing beyond generic H1 taker-side continuation (falsification-by-control cluster semantics)

rules.condition: SHADOW-CLOCKLONG out-earns ANCHOR on after-cost expectancy, OR |pooled Spearman rho(anchor per-decision returns, shadow per-decision returns)| > 0.20
rules.consequence: FALSIFIED - the book is the bare clock, not the mechanism

rules.condition: D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY inventory proxy including the H0 hygiene rows, measured on the exact representation_identity above
rules.consequence: D2 VETO recorded with margin (P-2); especially the dvol_level_log / dvol_shock proxies that killed WKNDLIQ

rules.condition: ANCHOR after-cost expectancy <= 0 at measured tier 2.0
rules.consequence: DEAD (mechanical reject); negative-first verdict stands, no re-parameterization

rules.condition: pooled |rho| between P1-ANCHOR and CNG1-A4-P2-ANCHOR per-decision return series > 0.20 (D2 measurement on both declared representations)
rules.consequence: the two proposals are ONE bet; only the stronger-evidenced mechanism advances to selection, the other is withdrawn - never both scored

expected_failure_interpretation: If F1 fires, the FOMC clock carries no incremental information beyond generic H1 imbalance continuation and the scheduled-announcement reaction family is dead on this substrate - it must NOT be re-clocked to other announcement series (CPI/NFP are BLOCKED anyway, so the next legal clock does not exist in evidence). If F4 fires with controls coherent (anchor loses, sham/shadow also lose), it is a plain negative: drained-liquidity under-reaction either does not exist at H1 granularity on these three books or is fully eaten by measured tier-2.0 costs. Either outcome feeds CRYPTO_NG1_REJECT_ALL, which the plan registers as a successful research run.
